SELECT
                    ssll.id, ssll.product_id, p.product as product_name,
                    p.prod_type, ssll.stock_before,
                    ssll.stock_after, ssll.pos_user_id, ssll.created_at,
                    ssll.comment, s.store_name, sss.storage_name

                    INNER JOIN
                        products as p ON ssll.product_id = p.id
                LEFT JOIN stores as s
                    ON ssll.store_id = s.id
                LEFT JOIN stock_storages as ss
                    ON ssll.storage_id = ss.id
                LEFT JOIN store_storages sss
                    ON sss.id = ss.id
                where
                    ssll.product_id = 20 and
                    ssll.store_id in (1, 2)
        order by id asc
